# usable-loop/v2 local contract

Skill: `verify-before-claim`  
Role: `claim-gate`

Consumes: `outcome-reference`, `review-record`.  
Produces: `outcome-reference`, `claim-boundary`, `claim-evidence-record`, `claim-record`.  
Optional on continuity trigger: `checkpoint`.

## Outcome Reference

```text
Contract: usable-loop/v2
Task ID:
Outcome Source kind: request | conversation | alignment-snapshot | issue | prd | spec | bug-repro | deployment-objective | other
Outcome Source ID:
Outcome Source locator:
Outcome Revision:
Revision basis:
Outcome Authority: authoritative | provisional
Authority basis:
Outcome lifecycle: active | superseded
Outcome snapshot:
Outcome currentness: fresh | stale
Supersedes, if any:
Stale when:
```

A current user request is authoritative when the user controls the scope
and no permission or designated-source conflict exists. Agent-derived or
reinterpreted meaning is provisional. Preserve Task ID across revisions.
Use an opaque revision such as `r1` unless canonical bytes were hashed.

## Invalidation

Any Outcome Revision, Boundary Digest, relevant code-state, or relevant
environment change makes dependent evidence, review, and claims stale.
Do not reuse old evidence after an unrelatedness argument in v2; rerun the
narrowest relevant check.

## Checkpoint projection

Default to a compact direct result. Expand the shared Checkpoint only for
pause/block, cross-session or agent handoff, context-compaction risk,
expensive/non-repeatable evidence, or explicit handoff request. If local
persistence is needed, rewrite the one `.scratch/<task-id>/STATE.md` Capsule.
It is an orientation cache, never authority or fresh evidence.
On resume, first reconcile the designated Outcome Source/Revision, then
read the Capsule for orientation, then recapture participating state.

Checkpoint fields: `task_id`, `outcome_reference`, `boundary_and_state`,
`done`, `next`, `blockers`, `decision_delta`, `evidence_delta`,
`supported_claims`, `still_unverified`, `stale_when`.

## Deterministic state runtime

Use the `scripts/handrails_state.py` beside this Skill, resolving
the path from this installed `SKILL.md` rather than the project cwd.
In the Agent Handrails source repository, the canonical equivalent is
`runtime/handrails_state.py`. Its interface is:

```text
inventory
confirm --kind claim|review --classifications <file|-> [--boundary-out <path>]
capture --boundary <confirmed-boundary.json>
```

Only classify runtime-generated Candidate/Hunk IDs. Every logical
unit needs one classification, a rationale, and `authorized |
needs-authorization | not-applicable`. Never invent or pass a naked
digest. Missing units, authorization conflicts, drift, and digest
mismatch block the operation.
In compact inventory, `classification_target=hunks` means classify
every `hunk_id`, never the parent Candidate ID. With
`classification_target=candidate`, classify the Candidate ID once.
Classification input has top-level `task_id`, `outcome_revision`,
`inventory_digest`, and `logical_units`. Each unit has `target_id`,
`classification`, `rationale`, and `authorization`; an actual Seed
may additionally supply `boundary_seed_digest`.
Keep machine inventories and full boundaries in private files; query
only the digest, counts, paths, and target IDs needed for the decision.
Never serialize all candidates or loop over Candidate/Hunk records to
stdout, even in compact form. Expose at most one target set per command
and write generated classifications privately without echoing units.
Never print raw lockfile or generated-artifact content; inspect its
source/check and emit only a mechanical summary of at most 40 lines.
A private path is outside participating worktrees or ignored but not
declared as a Boundary candidate. Never write machine evidence inside
a declared ignored artifact; that would immediately stale the state.
Rationale is canonical semantic content. Persist one confirmed
boundary with `--boundary-out`, then reuse that exact artifact for
`capture`; do not reconfirm merely to reconstruct its payload.
The persisted boundary is opaque: never open, parse, query, or print
it. Read scalar digests only from compact confirm/capture results.

## Claim routing

- `fact`: claim-evidence-without-boundary-or-review.
- `scoped-task`: claim-boundary-plus-claim-evidence.
- `high-assurance`: exact-matching-review-record-plus-claim-evidence.

Fact output is at most 12 lines; scoped-task output is at most 30
lines unless the user explicitly asks for full records.

## Record shapes

### `outcome-reference`

Required: `contract`, `task_id`, `source_kind`, `source_id`, `source_locator`, `outcome_revision`, `revision_basis`, `authority`, `authority_basis`, `lifecycle`, `snapshot`, `currentness`, `stale_when`.

Optional: `supersedes`.

### `review-record`

Required: `review_id`, `task_id`, `outcome_revision`, `boundary_digest`, `code_state_token`, `outcome_findings`, `quality_findings`, `recommendation`, `missing_evidence`, `reviewed_at`, `stale_when`.

### `claim-boundary`

Required: `canonical_payload`, `boundary_digest`, `code_state_token`, `confirmed_at`.

### `claim-evidence-record`

Required: `evidence_id`, `task_id`, `outcome_revision`, `code_state`, `environment`, `check`, `observed_result`, `scope`, `status`, `captured_at`, `stale_when`.

Optional: `boundary_digest`, `review_id`.

### `claim-record`

Required: `claim_id`, `task_id`, `outcome_revision`, `claim_kind`, `claim`, `evidence_ids`, `status`, `scope_limit`, `stale_when`.

Optional: `claim_boundary_digest`, `review_id`.

Conditional fields:

```json
{
  "fact": {
    "forbidden": [
      "claim_boundary_digest",
      "review_id"
    ]
  },
  "high-assurance": {
    "forbidden": [
      "claim_boundary_digest"
    ],

    ]
  },
  "scoped-task": {
    "forbidden": [
      "review_id"
    ],
    "required": [
      "claim_boundary_digest"
    ]
  }
}
```

### `checkpoint`

Required: `task_id`, `outcome_reference`, `boundary_and_state`, `done`, `next`, `blockers`, `decision_delta`, `evidence_delta`, `supported_claims`, `still_unverified`, `stale_when`.
